channel.title: ...Sings the Beatles
channel.desc: Recorded for the 40th anniversary of `Abbey Road', the Beatles' final album, a journey through the classic and curious covers in the BBC archives. Featuring Sandie Shaw singing a sassy `Day Tripper', Shirley Bassey belting out `Something', a close-harmony Carpenters cover of `Help!', Joe Cocker's chart-topping `With a Little Help from My Friends', and Oasis reinventing the `Walrus'.
